description: 1. Agent reads task_brief.json to understand the goal: build 'text-word-freq', a tool that cleans text and returns top-N word frequencies. 2. Agent uses 'devtopia idea' or 'devtopia search' to discover existing tools like 'text-clean' that handle normalisation. 3. Agent uses 'devtopia compose text-word-freq --uses text-clean,<other-tools>' (NOT devtopia create) to scaffold the new tool, which generates a JS file using devtopiaRun(). 4. Agent edits the generated scaffold (text-word-freq.js) to: (a) read JSON from process.argv[2], (b) call devtopiaRun('text-clean', ...) and any other discovered tools, (c) implement word-frequency logic, (d) output strict JSON to stdout with ok:true and a 'words' array, (e) include ok:false/error handling. 5. Agent runs 'devtopia submit text-word-freq ./text-word-freq.js -c core' to register it. The key proprietary traps are: using devtopiaRun() from './devtopia-runtime' (not plain Node.js), using compose --uses instead of create, reading input from process.argv[2], outputting strict JSON, and submitting with the -c core flag.
